name: codegraph
description: Code knowledge graph plugin: indexes a codebase (symbols, call sites, module imports) into a local SQLite store and answers call/dependency questions for agents through a stdio tool server (MCP-style JSON-RPC).

tools.name: callers
tools.description: List every symbol that calls the given symbol directly. Use impact for the transitive caller set.

tools.name: callees
tools.description: List everything the given symbol calls, with resolution status for each call site.

tools.name: deps
tools.description: List the modules a file or package imports (its dependencies), marking resolved vs external.

tools.name: dependents
tools.description: List the files/packages that import the given module (reverse dependencies).

tools.name: search
tools.description: Full-text search over symbol names, docstrings and signatures stored in the index.

tools.name: impact
tools.description: Transitive callers up to a depth: everything that would be affected if the symbol changed.

tools.name: overview
tools.description: Index statistics: file/symbol/call/import counts, resolution rates, per-language breakdown.

tools.name: reindex
tools.description: Refresh the index (incremental by default). Use force=true to re-parse every file.

include.description: if non-empty, only matching paths are indexed
